Our story

It started in a garage with one broken lamp and a stubborn idea: light should feel warm, not just bright.

Milestones

  • 2014 — the first lantern is sold at a weekend market
  • 2017 — we move into the harbour workshop
  • 2021 — our ten-thousandth lantern ships
  • 2025 — we open a repair café for old lamps

Home →

Meet the people

Eleven people work at the workshop today: glassblowers, carpenters, two engineers and one very patient bookkeeper.

Every Friday the whole team eats lunch together and votes on which prototype deserves another week of testing.

If you are ever near the harbour, drop by. The kettle is always on.
